ctx.x: Rafael Mendez, Manny Klein, all the musicians from the studio. They used to come up here. They was amazed, not amazed technically, because they was the best musicians in the United States in those days. It just our interpretation, they was amazed.
They liked it. Did they dance to it, Machito?
